title: Bitter Pepper Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry dish that combines bitter and sweet notes from the pepper and velvety sauce. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced bitter melon and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Pour in the velvety sauce and stir to coat the vegetables.
Add the soy sauce (if using) and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with sesame seeds and scallions (if desired).
Optional: Serve over steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
